faqs.q: Does Gaynor do one to one training, and would it suit my dog?
faqs.a: Yes. A one to one is a bespoke session with Gaynor, working on the aspects of dog training you are finding difficult and finding the solutions. It suits owners who work shifts or have time constraints that make a weekly class hard, who want help to reach a higher standard, who have one specific problem to work on, or who feel self-conscious training with other people around — and sometimes classes are simply not suitable for a dog's temperament.
